observations: Photo 0 shows a large black plastic water tank with a ribbed, circular base and a metal frame.
The tank has a blue spigot on the side and a white label with a logo and text.
In the background, there are multiple similar tanks, some black and some white, stacked or placed side by side.
The tanks appear to be made of thick plastic, likely for water storage.
The setting is outdoors on a dirt ground, under bright sunlight.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the image.

claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the tank, but there is no visual proof of its use in a house or other places. The seller's statement is not contradicted but not proven.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tank may have cracks, leaks, or structural damage not visible in the photo.

risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially leaking or structurally compromised

risks.risk: The tank may not be food-grade or may have been previously used for non-food purposes.
risks.proof: A close-up of the label or any markings indicating food-grade certification or previous use.

risks.risk: The tank may be damaged or have internal contamination not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the inside of the tank, or a close-up of the base and bottom.

proof_requests: Close-up of the tank's surface, especially around the spigot and seams, under bright light.
Close-up of the label or any markings indicating food-grade certification or previous use.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
